edge: saved positive reciprocal same-candidate local projected-feature edge; not semantic identity
edge_measure: sum weights with both actual retained endpoints / all positive saved edge weights; no graph => unknown
path_measure: two consecutive edges through same middle vertex, min(weight1,weight2); all three actual retained vertices; context two cells not applicable
aggregation: window graph ratios mean within parent then equal eight parents per domain; context and local separately; no graph unknown, not zero
conditional_paired_C_trigger: one paired-endpoint construction only if local source-macro retained-edge ratio C minus B is <=0 in at least one domain with eight evaluable sources; otherwise not triggered; no both-domain benefit gate
